name: Branislav Ivanović
bio:
Branislav Ivanović brings decades of motorsport experience to Tickford Racing, a career born from a childhood spent tinkering with engines in his father's Belgrade workshop. From humble beginnings as a mechanic's assistant, Branislav's meticulous approach and sharp eye for detail quickly propelled him through the ranks. He honed his expertise across various disciplines, including rallycross and touring cars, developing a reputation for his problem-solving abilities and unwavering commitment to excellence.

As Head of Operations, Branislav orchestrates the intricate logistics and personnel management that underpin Tickford's racing endeavors. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. While his demanding standards can sometimes ruffle feathers, Branislav's ultimate goal remains the relentless pursuit of peak performance and championship success. His visionary approach lies in blending time-honored motorsport principles with cutting-edge technological advancements, always seeking that extra edge on the competition.

physical.description: A stout man with a commanding presence and a stern but fair gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and annotations.
Insists on personally inspecting every car before each race, regardless of the hour.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
